title: Adding a version says where the second drawing is going
goal: Adding a second look to a component quietly puts a whole second drawing on your canvas, next to the first one, wherever there happens to be room. Nothing warns you, and on a canvas you are already working on it can land on top of what you were doing. Make it clear what just appeared and where.
notes: Found in the 2026-09-07 whole-path sitting. On the first pass the copies dropped afterwards landed straight on the new Disabled drawing. addComponentVersion in EditorState places the copied drawing beside the original; it needs a placement that avoids occupied space, and the canvas needs to say the drawing arrived (the toast idiom used elsewhere).
acceptance: Adding a version brings the new drawing into view and selects it, so you can see what arrived
The new drawing never lands on top of an existing layer
One undo removes the drawing and the version together
